title: The honour guard in the Old Crypts attacks the instant you enter with no warning beat, and its offered peaceful option ('speak the old rest-rite,' a will check) fails at even odds with no indication that a miss makes it immediately attack a party member rather than the player — Lys dropped from full to 4/10 hp on the one failed attempt.
where: The Old Crypts / 'speak the old rest-rite at it'
